observed_failure: Native host-observer D startup found only 9.43 GiB free. Required 63.35 GiB. No measured requests were produced.
cause: A completed launcher restored Burners outside quiet_lane.lock. A second launcher had acquired the lock but had not created its D CUDA context.
fix: Use quiet_lane.lock for group-final restoration as well as experiment startup.
validity: The failed host-observer cell is invalid and preserved. It is not a Dense AR capacity or Layer continuation failure. New controls require a new namespace.
future_rule: Do not queue a new group behind a pre-fix launcher. Wait for all pre-fix launchers to finish.
